votes.motion: Kory Luker moved to approve the Planning Commission meeting minutes of December 1, 2021

Ulisses Flynn moved to approve the Quail Ridge Phase 1, 2nd Amended Plat Application 2021-09 subject to the following: 2 BLUFFDALE CITY PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING MINUTES Wednesday, January 5, 2022 Conditions: 1. That all requirements of the City Code and adopted ordinances are adhered to for the application. 2. That the applicant provides approval from Salt Lake County Flood Control for the stormwater discharge associated with this project. 3. That the applicant provides approval from South Valley Sewer District for this project

Ulisscs Flynn moved to forward a positive recommendation to the City Council for the General Plan Land Use Map Amendment Application for 2.91 acres located at approximately 13820 South 2700 West from Very Low-Density Residential to Neighborhood Commercial based on the following: Findings: 1. That the zoning amendment provides the scale and types of businesses that contribute to neighborhood character. 2. That the zoning amendment will provide low-intensity neighborhood uses, such as assisted living
